meanings.en: a puzzle that is difficult to solve
meanings.exampleEn: The magazine includes a weekly brainteaser for its readers.
meanings.exampleTr: Dergi okuyucuları için haftalık bir zeka oyunu içeriyor.

meanings.en: having learned the skills for a particular job or activity
meanings.exampleEn: She is a trained nurse with ten years of experience.
meanings.exampleTr: O, on yıllık deneyime sahip eğitimli bir hemşiredir.

meanings.en: officially recognized as meeting a standard
meanings.exampleEn: He is a certified accountant working for a large firm.
meanings.exampleTr: O, büyük bir firmada çalışan belgeli bir muhasebecidir.

meanings.en: not having the necessary skills or qualifications
meanings.exampleEn: He was unqualified for the position and was not hired.
meanings.exampleTr: O, pozisyon için niteliksizdi ve işe alınmadı.

meanings.en: of very good quality
meanings.exampleEn: The factory uses only high-grade steel in its products.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika ürünlerinde yalnızca yüksek kaliteli çelik kullanır.

meanings.en: the act of releasing something such as gas or radiation
meanings.exampleEn: New laws aim to reduce the emission of harmful gases.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasalar zararlı gazların salımını azaltmayı hedefliyor.

meanings.en: a fence or barrier made of rails
meanings.exampleEn: She leaned against the railing to look at the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Nehre bakmak için korkuluğa yaslandı.

meanings.en: rain, snow, or other moisture that falls to the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The region receives heavy precipitation during winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölge kış aylarında yoğun yağış alır.

meanings.en: the state of existing in reality
meanings.exampleEn: In actuality, the project took twice as long as planned.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerçeklikte, proje planlanandan iki kat uzun sürdü.

meanings.en: to build or create something again
meanings.exampleEn: Engineers will reconstruct the bridge after the flood.
meanings.exampleTr: Mühendisler selden sonra köprüyü yeniden inşa edecek.

meanings.en: the reception area of a hotel or office
meanings.exampleEn: Please leave your key at the front desk when you check out.
meanings.exampleTr: Çıkış yaparken anahtarınızı resepsiyona bırakın.

meanings.en: to tell someone about something that happened
meanings.exampleEn: He began to recount his adventures in the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlardaki maceralarını anlatmaya başladı.

meanings.en: to recover from illness or exhaustion
meanings.exampleEn: She went to the coast to recuperate after her surgery.
meanings.exampleTr: Ameliyatından sonra iyileşmek için sahile gitti.

meanings.en: an official who enforces the rules in certain sports
meanings.exampleEn: The umpire signalled that the ball was out.
meanings.exampleTr: Hakem topun dışarı çıktığını işaret etti.

meanings.en: small amounts of food eaten between meals
meanings.exampleEn: We bought some snacks for the long car journey.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun araba yolculuğu için biraz atıştırmalık aldık.

meanings.en: the act of officially joining a course or institution
meanings.exampleEn: Enrolment for the new term begins next Monday.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni dönem kaydı önümüzdeki pazartesi başlıyor.

meanings.en: in comparison with something else
meanings.exampleEn: The winter was comparatively mild this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yıl kış nispeten ılımandı.

meanings.en: making someone feel relaxed and peaceful
meanings.exampleEn: The soft music had a calming effect on the children.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumuşak müzik çocuklar üzerinde sakinleştirici bir etki yarattı.

meanings.en: having a gentle, calming effect
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke in a soothing voice to calm the frightened child.
meanings.exampleTr: Korkmuş çocuğu sakinleştirmek için yatıştırıcı bir sesle konuştu.

meanings.en: deeply religious and committed to faith
meanings.exampleEn: She was a devout Christian who prayed every day.
meanings.exampleTr: Her gün dua eden dindar bir Hristiyandı.

meanings.en: not connected with religion or spiritual matters
meanings.exampleEn: The country has a secular system of government.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin laik bir yönetim sistemi var.

meanings.en: a small remaining part of something
meanings.exampleEn: The old wall is a remnant of the city's medieval fortress.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski duvar, şehrin ortaçağ kalesinden kalan bir kalıntıdır.

meanings.en: an act of honouring the memory of a person or event
meanings.exampleEn: A ceremony was held in commemoration of the fallen soldiers.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehit askerleri anmak için bir tören düzenlendi.

meanings.en: to return money owed to someone
meanings.exampleEn: I will pay back the money I borrowed next week.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödünç aldığım parayı gelecek hafta geri ödeyeceğim.

meanings.en: to pay back money spent on behalf of others
meanings.exampleEn: The company will reimburse you for your travel expenses.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket seyahat masraflarınızı geri ödeyecek.

meanings.en: repeatedly, many times
meanings.exampleEn: He listened to the same song over and over all day.
meanings.exampleTr: Aynı şarkıyı bütün gün tekrar tekrar dinledi.

meanings.en: a form of government with a king or queen as head of state
meanings.exampleEn: The United Kingdom is a constitutional monarchy.
meanings.exampleTr: Birleşik Krallık anayasal bir monarşidir.

meanings.en: something required before something else can happen
meanings.exampleEn: A degree in biology is a prerequisite for this course.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ders için biyoloji diploması bir ön koşuldur.

meanings.en: to have a similar appearance to someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: You look like your mother when you smile.
meanings.exampleTr: Gülümsediğinde annene benziyorsun.

meanings.en: a place where someone lives
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient dwelling was carved into the side of the cliff.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik konut kayalığın yamacına oyulmuştu.

meanings.en: to resist or endure something successfully
meanings.exampleEn: The bridge was built to withstand strong earthquakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Köprü güçlü depremlere dayanacak şekilde inşa edildi.

meanings.en: a lack of respect toward someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: His rude comments showed great disrespect for the teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaba yorumları öğretmene büyük saygısızlık gösterdi.

meanings.en: deserving respect and showing high moral standards
meanings.exampleEn: It was an honourable decision to admit his mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatasını kabul etmek onurlu bir karardı.

meanings.en: not respected or considered honest
meanings.exampleEn: He avoided doing business with disreputable companies.
meanings.exampleTr: İtibarsız şirketlerle iş yapmaktan kaçındı.

meanings.en: responsible and required to explain one's actions
meanings.exampleEn: Managers are accountable for their team's performance.
meanings.exampleTr: Yöneticiler ekiplerinin performansından sorumludur.

meanings.en: to repair and improve an old building
meanings.exampleEn: They plan to renovate the old farmhouse next summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecek yaz eski çiftlik evini yenilemeyi planlıyorlar.

meanings.en: understanding of an event only after it has happened
meanings.exampleEn: In hindsight, we should have left earlier to avoid traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonradan düşününce, trafikten kaçınmak için daha erken çıkmalıydık.

meanings.en: the ability to predict and prepare for the future
meanings.exampleEn: She had the foresight to save money for emergencies.
meanings.exampleTr: Acil durumlar için para biriktirme öngörüsüne sahipti.

meanings.en: to bring together again after separation
meanings.exampleEn: The charity helped to reunite the lost child with his family.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayır kurumu kaybolan çocuğu ailesiyle yeniden kavuşturdu.

meanings.en: to make changes to a document or law to improve it
meanings.exampleEn: Parliament voted to amend the existing law.
meanings.exampleTr: Parlamento mevcut yasayı değiştirmek için oy kullandı.

meanings.en: not yet ready to be eaten or harvested
meanings.exampleEn: The unripe bananas were still green and hard.
meanings.exampleTr: Olgunlaşmamış muzlar hâlâ yeşil ve sertti.

meanings.en: the side or edge of a road
meanings.exampleEn: Wildflowers grew along the wayside in spring.
meanings.exampleTr: İlkbaharda yol kenarı boyunca yabani çiçekler yetişti.

meanings.en: a robot designed to look and act like a human
meanings.exampleEn: In the film, an android served as the ship's pilot.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmde bir android geminin pilotu olarak görev yaptı.

meanings.en: having a smoothly rising and falling form
meanings.exampleEn: The road wound through undulating green hills.
meanings.exampleTr: Yol dalgalanan yeşil tepelerin arasından kıvrılarak geçiyordu.

meanings.en: rotted or broken down over time
meanings.exampleEn: The dentist removed the decayed tooth.
meanings.exampleTr: Dişçi çürümüş dişi çekti.

meanings.en: no longer good to use, or given too much attention
meanings.exampleEn: The milk had spoiled and smelled sour.
meanings.exampleTr: Süt bozulmuştu ve ekşi kokuyordu.

meanings.en: shaped like a sphere or ball
meanings.exampleEn: The planet is almost perfectly spherical.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezegen neredeyse mükemmel şekilde küreseldir.

meanings.en: a milky fluid from plants used to make rubber
meanings.exampleEn: The gloves are made from natural latex.
meanings.exampleTr: Eldivenler doğal lateksten yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: a person who is running away to avoid being caught
meanings.exampleEn: The fugitive was finally captured after two years.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaçak iki yıl sonra nihayet yakalandı.

meanings.en: a strip of land used for aircraft to take off and land
meanings.exampleEn: The small plane landed on a remote jungle airstrip.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük uçak uzak bir orman pistine indi.

meanings.en: holy, or fortunate to have something good
meanings.exampleEn: We feel blessed to have such a loving family.
meanings.exampleTr: Böylesine sevgi dolu bir aileye sahip olduğumuz için kendimizi şanslı hissediyoruz.

meanings.en: showing disrespect for religion or sacred things
meanings.exampleEn: He was scolded for using profane language in church.
meanings.exampleTr: Kilisede küfürlü dil kullandığı için azarlandı.

meanings.en: the act of protecting against attack
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers prepared a strong defence of the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler şehrin güçlü bir savunmasını hazırladılar.

meanings.en: in a safe or firmly fixed way
meanings.exampleEn: Make sure the door is securely locked before you leave.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayrılmadan önce kapının güvenli bir şekilde kilitlendiğinden emin olun.

meanings.en: courage and determination, or small bits of stone
meanings.exampleEn: It took real grit to finish the marathon in the rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmurda maratonu bitirmek gerçek bir azim gerektirdi.

meanings.en: fiction based on imagined science and technology
meanings.exampleEn: He loves reading sci-fi novels about space travel.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzay yolculuğu hakkındaki bilim kurgu romanlarını okumayı çok sever.

meanings.en: to officially express strong disapproval to someone
meanings.exampleEn: The manager had to reprimand the employee for being late.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür geç kaldığı için çalışanı azarlamak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to criticize someone sharply for a fault
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher rebuked the boy for cheating on the test.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen sınavda kopya çektiği için çocuğu azarladı.

meanings.en: to remove something from a surface with a sharp edge
meanings.exampleEn: She used a knife to scrape the paint off the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Boyayı pencereden kazımak için bir bıçak kullandı.

meanings.en: an object or design made by cutting wood or stone
meanings.exampleEn: The temple is famous for its ancient stone carvings.
meanings.exampleTr: Tapınak antik taş oymalarıyla ünlüdür.

meanings.en: relating to or living in salty sea water
meanings.exampleEn: Sharks are saltwater creatures found in oceans.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpekbalıkları okyanuslarda bulunan tuzlu su canlılarıdır.

meanings.en: relating to water that is not salty, as in rivers and lakes
meanings.exampleEn: Trout are freshwater fish that live in rivers.
meanings.exampleTr: Alabalık nehirlerde yaşayan tatlı su balıklarıdır.

meanings.en: a large brown seaweed that grows in cold seas
meanings.exampleEn: Sea otters live among the thick kelp forests.
meanings.exampleTr: Deniz su samurları yoğun deniz yosunu ormanları arasında yaşar.

meanings.en: simple plant-like organisms that grow in water
meanings.exampleEn: Green algae covered the surface of the pond.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeşil algler gölet yüzeyini kapladı.

meanings.en: previously owned by someone else; secondhand
meanings.exampleEn: They bought a pre-owned car at a good price.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi bir fiyata ikinci el bir araba aldılar.

meanings.en: in a secret or hidden manner
meanings.exampleEn: The agents covertly entered the building at night.
meanings.exampleTr: Ajanlar gece gizlice binaya girdiler.

meanings.en: a feeling of uncertainty or lack of confidence
meanings.exampleEn: His insecurity made it hard for him to speak in public.
meanings.exampleTr: Güvensizliği topluluk önünde konuşmasını zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: to release one's hold, or to dismiss someone
meanings.exampleEn: You need to let go of the past and move forward.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçmişi bırakıp ileriye doğru ilerlemen gerekiyor.

meanings.en: thinking only about oneself and one's own needs
meanings.exampleEn: He was too self-centred to notice his friend's sadness.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşının üzüntüsünü fark edemeyecek kadar bencildi.

meanings.en: thinking too highly of oneself; excessively self-important
meanings.exampleEn: Her egotistical manner annoyed everyone at the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini beğenmiş tavrı toplantıdaki herkesi rahatsız etti.
